title: 4-7-8 breathing, the one people reach for when winding down at night:

copy.threads_text:
4-7-8 breathing, the one people reach for when winding down at night:

In for 4. Hold for 7. Out slowly for 8.

Start with four rounds. If the hold makes you lightheaded, skip it and just lengthen the exhale. Free timer:
